$comment: Static mounts: a URL prefix served from a directory under /app. GENERATED from route.ts on 2026-10-03 and read back by `routeKit.resolveMount()`, so there is one declaration of what is mounted where. This is routing DATA - three prefixes and three directories - and it was three near-identical branches in the dispatcher, each repeating the same `..` guard. `indexFallback` is the one bit that differed between them: `/plugins/<name>` serves that directory's index.html when the path has no extension.
